snippet.title: Gorgon's Garden - From niche forums to an old, near-defunct MMO... A nightmare unfolds!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://feverdreamjohnny.itch.io/gorgons-garden?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt On a summer day in 2008 you find yourself lurking on Hypogeum.net, a niche forum that used to be centered around an MMO known as "Gorgon's Garden," before the game became inaccessible due to the introduction of a paywall for a long-defunct digital currency.

However... The forum's resident hacker has successfully managed to crack said MMO, removing the paywall and allowing users to explore it all over again.

So you download the cracker and run it... 

And that's when the trouble starts.

Gorgon's Garden is a love letter to old forum culture and the generally more earnest and amateur tone of older creepypastas. It's a bit of horror, a bit of humor, all contained within a virtual desktop you can toy around with. Change your cursor, download weird images to set as your background, pick through bizarre forums with a colorful cast of characters, and explore an MMO that seems curiously devoid of any other players...
